page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at left; two lines of text above the diagram; below the text a circular compass-rose diagram with labels around the ring (not transcribed as text, described under notes); a small word "Index" at lower right, which is a catchword-like marker outside the text block.

main_text.l: aut mappa, monstrans in quam cœli plagam dirigen-
da sit prora, & quo vento de loco in locum navigan-
Harum linearum origo est ex compasso nautico,
qui & index Nauticus magis latine dicitur.

page.notes: The compass-rose diagram is a circular figure with a ring of labels in German and Dutch, with the cardinal points MERIDIES, OCCASUS, SEPTENTRIO and ORTUS on the outer ring, and the inner labels Süd, Südwest, West, Nordwest, Nord, Nordost, Ost, Südost and intermediate points (e.g. Süd süd West, Ost süd Ost, Nord nord Ost). The labels are part of the diagram and are not transcribed as text. The word "Index" at lower right is a marginal mark outside the text block.
